nodes.description: Mapping of holder address to token balance in BMT; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance; written by approve, decremented by transferFrom.
Public total supply of tokens, assigned in the constructor from _totalSupply with no consistency check against minted balances.
Mapping marking accounts as frozen; written only by freeze (minter gated) and read by transfer/transferFrom.
Privileged minter address, set to msg.sender in the constructor; used as the only access-control anchor (freeze).
Public decimals of the token, assigned in the BMT constructor.
Public token name string, assigned in the BMT constructor.
Public token symbol string, assigned in the BMT constructor.
BMT(uint256,string,uint8,uint256,string): sets minter=msg.sender, credits balances[msg.sender]=initialSupply, stores name/decimals/symbol and totalSupply.
transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after balance, overflow-style and freeze checks; performs unchecked += and -= on balances.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens from _from to _to using allowance allowed[_from][msg.sender]; unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
balanceOf(address) constant: returns balances[_owner].
freezeAccountOf(address) constant: returns freezeAccount[_owner].
freeze(address,uint): only callable by minter (throw on mismatch); writes freezeAccount[account]=key. Only owner-controlled privileged function in the contract.
approve(address,uint256): sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender]=_value and emits Approval; no upper-bound or freeze check.
allowance(address,address) constant: returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
msg.sender in the BMT constructor; becomes minter and receives the entire initial token supply.
msg.sender in transfer; the untrusted caller that owns the debited balance and is checked against freezeAccount.
msg.sender in transferFrom; untrusted spender whose allowance and target balances are debited without reentrancy or ordering protection.
msg.sender in approve; untrusted owner key of the allowed mapping.
msg.sender in freeze; compared to minter for authorization, so access control depends entirely on this untrusted value.
Unchecked arithmetic in BMT.transfer: balances[msg.sender] -= _value and balances[_to] += _value with an overflow check done in the wrong order/only against self-arithmetic.
Unchecked arithmetic in BMT.transferFrom: balances[_to] += _value, balances[_from] -= _value and allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Access-control operation in BMT.freeze: if (msg.sender != minter) throw; the sole privileged guard in the contract, revert-based and single-keyed.
Constructor assigns balances[msg.sender]=initialSupply and totalSupply=_totalSupply independently, so declared supply is not bound to actual minted balances and any value can be passed.

transferFrom reads freezeAccount[_from] as a transfer precondition.
